name: Bloody Bone Necklace
summary: A Bloody Bone Necklace is a Bloodscalp troll trophy taken in Stranglethorn Vale. Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp uses the necklaces in a ritual against his tribe's enemy.

sections.title: A Troll Trophy
sections.body: Kin'weelay asks you to bring twenty-five Bloody Bone Necklaces to Grom'gol Base Camp. The Bloodscalp tribe dwells to the north and is Kin'weelay's enemy. He believes taking their trophies will give his own tribe power over them.

sections.title: Kin'weelay's Rite
sections.body: At Grom'gol, Kin'weelay boils the necklaces and leeches them, rendering them to paste. He says the rite will weaken the spirits of their owners. For this service, he says he repays his debt to you.

faq.q: What is a Bloody Bone Necklace?
faq.answer: A Bloody Bone Necklace is a trophy taken from a Bloodscalp troll in Stranglethorn Vale.
Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp asks for twenty-five Bloody Bone Necklaces.

faq.q: Where do the necklaces come from?
faq.answer: Bloodscalp trolls in Stranglethorn Vale wear the bloody bone necklaces.
Kin'weelay says taking trophies from the Bloodscalp tribe gives his own tribe power over its enemy.

faq.q: What does Kin'weelay do with the necklaces?
faq.answer: Kin'weelay boils and leeches the necklaces, then renders them to paste in a rite meant to weaken their owners' spirits.
Kin'weelay is at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

angles.text: As a troll, you can see Kin'weelay turn a trophy of the Bloodscalp tribe into a ritual weapon against its owners.
As a member of the Horde, you can help Kin'weelay, a troll at the Horde camp of Grom'gol, oppose the Bloodscalp tribe.
